filler-localization.goal: Audio-grounded filler localisation: locate filled pauses in the learner's own audio, with a position, so the coach can point at the moment.
notes: No filler route passed on 2026-10-20. The recogniser omitted both hesitations that the owner confirmed were audible in the reviewed clip, so transcript-based counting cannot be audio analysis.
The goal is preserved, not narrowed: this state is a data value, and the owner decides the scope. A later validated detector flips data only.
While this state stands, the UI and the coach render insufficient_evidence. A missing or unvalidated filler is never written as 0.

pause-detection.goal: Estimate where the learner paused inside a turn, anchored to the learner's own audio clock.
pause-detection.validatedBy: Phase 02 offline probe: Silero VAD over ONNX Runtime against exact synthetic labels
notes: Silero VAD over ONNX Runtime matched exact synthetic labels (worst boundary error 44 ms) on clear-utterance, one-word and known-internal-gap fixtures.
The check ran on generated signals only. It proves the mechanism and framing, not behaviour on natural learner speech.
The published baseline 44 ms figure is the synthetic worst case; the 300 ms target is the p95 target for natural speech and has not been measured.

speech-rate.goal: Report the learner's overall speaking rate as recognised words over the elapsed learner-audio span.
speech-rate.validatedBy: Phase 02 offline probe: four-denominator metrics on synthetic fixtures
notes: The denominator is the elapsed learner-audio span on the sample clock, never connection or session time.
The numerator comes from speech-to-text, so a recognition error changes the number. Only synthetic fixtures have been measured.

speech-active-rate.goal: Report the learner's speaking rate over speech-active time only, so pauses do not distort it.
speech-active-rate.validatedBy: Phase 02 offline probe: four-denominator metrics on synthetic fixtures
notes: Kept separate from the overall rate: the two are different quantities and may never share a method or a denominator.

turn-duration.goal: Report how long the learner's own audio ran in a turn, measured on the learner's sample clock.
turn-duration.validatedBy: Phase 02 offline probe: learner sample clock with padding kept separate
notes: The anchor is the local sample clock: genuine samples submitted, with deliberate end padding counted separately and excluded.
Connection time and session time are never used as the duration.

conversation-coach.goal: Hold a natural spoken conversation and coach in the learner's language, with audio-grounded feedback.
notes: One complete STT to Gemini to TTS turn succeeded, and Gemini answered 10 of 11 languages, then returned a bounded timeout for Tamil and later network-category failures from the same environment.
Nobody listened to any synthesised utterance and no reply was scored for teaching value, so intelligibility and coaching quality are unproven in every language.
The browser path, interruption and cancellation in a real call have never been run.
